title: Aubin–Talenti Optimizers for Critical Dirac Potentials
exact_target: Determine whether the critical optimizing Dirac potential in every dimension greater than one has the proposed Aubin--Talenti form.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005664 (OWR-14297742-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/39, pp. 2247--2302. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The admissible exponent range and critical parameter are those of the cited spectral problem, not arbitrary choices of $p$ or potential norm.
